guard: Both broker renderers render `max_file_store` inside the `jetstream{}` block when `maxFileStore` is set, render byte-identical config when it is unset, and refuse a non-positive or non-integer cap naming the option (#1888).
why: The suite imports the renderers from `src`, so no build is needed and each mutant is what the suite reads.

The first mutant keeps the option accepted and validated but drops the rendered line, which is the silent-ignore shape: the operator asks for a cap and the broker runs on the dynamic default. The others break the unset bytes, the refusal, and the serverConfig hand-off one at a time.

mutations.name: a set cap is validated but not rendered
mutations.expectRed: openServerConfig: a set maxFileStore renders max_file_store inside the jetstream block
mutations.cell: openServerConfig: a set maxFileStore renders max_file_store inside the jetstream block

mutations.name: unset renders a different jetstream line
mutations.expectRed: openServerConfig: unset maxFileStore renders byte-identical config
mutations.cell: openServerConfig: unset maxFileStore renders byte-identical config

mutations.name: an invalid cap is rendered instead of refused
mutations.expectRed: openServerConfig: maxFileStore 0 is refused naming the option
mutations.cell: openServerConfig: maxFileStore 0 is refused naming the option

mutations.name: serverConfig drops the cap on the way to the block
mutations.expectRed: serverConfig: a set maxFileStore renders max_file_store inside the jetstream block
mutations.cell: serverConfig: a set maxFileStore renders max_file_store inside the jetstream block
